column1: # One row per case; a case is (app, case) and must be unique. Tab-separated, "-" = empty.
#   gpus       HPCPERF_GPUS for the run (one MPI rank per GPU through the common launcher)
#   env        NAME=VALUE;NAME=VALUE -- only variables the application's run.sh reads
#              (`tools/timing/cases.py allowed-env <app>` lists them). A variable set in your
#              shell but not declared here is REFUSED: every run starts from `env -i`.
#   sweep      one variable may take several values NAME=a|b|c; the case name needs {} for it
#   args       extra arguments appended to run.sh
# "default" is the case run.sh runs with no input set. The n{}/p{} rows are small
# demonstration sweeps that exercise the multi-input path end to end.

column8: demonstration sweep: local grid per rank (default case is 256^3)
demonstration sweep: particles per rank (default case is 100000)
